My dear [Mr Macmillan](/person/939),
Thank you for your note. [Miss Sewell](/person/1301) is coming here to talk the matter over, and sketch our plans next Wednesday week and then I will write again[^1]

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: These were plans for [Historical Selections](/book/71).
